name: LMEX
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The LMEX Stock Exchange's community issued a notice on the adjustment of exchange operations, stating that the platform was hacked and stolen and lost 150,000 USDT, which caused the platform to have a low debt. The deposit and withdrawal have been closed.
